texts.zh:
一个故障的继电器正在干扰方舟舰[Root.GetName]的能源核心。除了无法动弹之外，住宅区的灯光也正在熄灭。农场报告能源涌动异常，几个关键研究模块已经离线。

我们的总工程师警告说，如果不加以干预，连锁故障将蔓延至整艘飞船。不幸的是，解决方案并不简单。修复继电器需要从储备中抽调资源，而绕过它则有损害方舟舰长期稳定性的风险。

冷却中的飞船发出令人不安的吱嘎声和呻吟声。我们现在需要做出决定。
texts.en:
A faulty relay is interfering with the Arkship [Root.GetName]'s power core. In addition to being immobilized, the lights are now going out on residential decks. Farms report irregular energy surges, and several key research modules have gone offline.

Our chief engineers warn that without intervention, cascading failures will spread throughout the ship. Unfortunately the solution is not straightforward. Repairing the relay will require diverting resources from our reserves, while bypassing it risks compromising the Arkship's long-term stability.

The cooling ship creaks and groans unsettlingly. We need to make a decision now.

label.zh: 不惜一切代价，把它修好。
label.en: Spare no expense and repair it properly.

tooltips.zh: 这将改善旅客满意度，但是会恶化船员压力水平。
tooltips.en: This will improve Passenger Satisfaction, but hurt Crew Stress Level.

label.zh: 修修补补继续用吧，我们现在得勒紧裤腰带过日子。
label.en: Patch it and move on. We cannot afford luxuries.

tooltips.zh: 这将改善船员压力水平，但是会恶化旅客满意度。
tooltips.en: This will improve Crew Stress Level, but hurt Passenger Satisfaction.

texts.zh: 尽管困难重重，方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的工程船员不仅修复了故障继电器，还对其进行了改进。现在，全舰的能量分配比以往任何时候都更加顺畅，多年来一直不稳定的系统也得以稳定。船员士气大幅提升，许多人对方舟舰的韧性表现出了新的自豪感。
texts.en: Against all odds, the engineering crew on Arkship [Root.GetName] has not only repaired the faulty relay, but improved it. Energy distribution across the ship is now smoother than ever, stabilizing systems that have been temperamental for years. Crew morale has risen sharply, with many expressing newfound pride in the Arkship's resilience.

texts.zh: 对飞船[Root.GetName]能源核心的快速修复暂时有效。但临时旁路电路在持续使用下已不堪重负。频繁的全船断电已成为常态，一些区域的环境控制在过热和过冷之间摇摆不定。船员抱怨领导层选择了权宜之计而非安全。低语流传着，方舟舰正在变成一座修修补补的遗迹，而非一座坚韧的灯塔。
texts.en: The quick fix on the Arkship [Root.GetName]'s power core is holding, at least for now. But the makeshift bypass circuits are straining under constant use. Frequent ship-wide blackouts are now a way of life, and environmental controls in some sections have been oscillating between too hot, and too cold. The crew grumble that leadership chose expedience over security. Whispers circulate that the Arkship is becoming a patchwork relic, rather than a beacon of endurance.

label.en: We must make do and mend.
